 Hi Friends, 
 Hope you are doing great, 
 
 I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your consultant updated profile ASAP. 
 
 Position: Biztalk Integration Developer 
 Location: Little Rock, AR 
 Duration: 8-12 months 
 
 Notes: 
 Additional responsibilities include participation in the development and execution of unit and system test plans and lead workshops. The interface developer should have the following skills: 
 
 • Extensive Knowledge of algorithm development 
 • Strong organizational and time management skills 
 • Extensive Knowledge of .NET development 
 • Extensive Knowledge of development using BizTalk 
 • Knowledge of database usage, able to write and optimize SQL is mandatory 
 • Ability to translate project specifications into development tasks 
 • Strong analytical skills 
 • Comfortable with creating user interfaces (web forms), focusing on user experience and system steadiness and efficiency 
 • Must be able to lead workshops with the business. 
 • Desire and ability to clearly communicate with colleagues at all levels 
 • Ability to successfully complete tasks with limited supervision. 
 • Business Analyst experience preferred but not required 
 
 - Interface development: The activities around interface development will require the use of BizTalk and SSIS to automate business processes. It is expected that all consultants will follow industry’s best practices by taking into account tasks including, but not limited to: 
 § Error handling 
 § Logging 
 § Notification 
 § Variable and parameter management 
 § Serialization 
 § Parallelization 
 § Security 


 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id alih (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-955-3955
